final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PLT) AS avg_plt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS overall_avg FROM g), diffs AS (SELECT g.ID, g.SEX, g.avg_plt, g.avg_plt - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), sex_avg AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(diff) AS sex_diff_avg FROM diffs GROUP BY SEX), final AS (SELECT d.avg_plt, d.diff, d.diff - s.sex_diff_avg AS adj FROM diffs d JOIN sex_avg s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.diff > s.sex_diff_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS avg_group_plt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(adj) AS avg_adj FROM final
